stations.title: Ossian
stations.say: The office wants every till tonight.

stations.title: Old program
stations.text: Read tills one by one, stopped at a bad one

stations.title: Harbour office
stations.say: The whole day, the bad till named.

captions: Closing at Lanternquay. Each boat's till writes its own file for the harbour office.
The relief boat's till broke mid line, and the old program stopped and sent nothing.
You read every till at the same time and gather the answers, the bad till included.
All tills are read together, the bad one is named, and the takings add up exactly.
The office has the whole day before the last bus, and the hut has its program.
